# CANDIDATE: DIX_HIGH_GEX_NEG_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A rising dark‑pool short‑volume ratio (DIX) above 0.55 for two consecutive 5‑minute bars, combined with negative dealer gamma exposure (GEX) below −0.5 bn, indicates increasing downside hedging pressure from dealers and short‑biased flows. This confluence suggests elevated probability of a short‑side breakdown when price breaks below the opening range low on expanding volume and the EMA ribbon is bearish, offering an edge for short entries during elevated volatility (VIX > 18) and mid‑morning EST.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger when all conditions align on the same 5‑minute bar:  
1) DIX > 0.55 for current and prior bar (two‑bar confirmation),  
2) GEX < −0.5 bn (latest available),  
3) Price breaks below the opening range low (ORL) defined from 09:30–09:35 ET,  
4) Volume on the breakout bar exceeds 2× the 20‑bar average volume,  
5) EMA ribbon bearish: 8‑period EMA < 21‑period EMA < 55‑period EMA on the 5‑minute chart.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the most recent swing high (prior higher high) for structure invalidation. First profit target at 1.5× risk (R). Remaining position trailed at 12% below the high‑water mark (chandelier-style) to capture extended moves. Regime filters: only active when VIX > 18 and time between 10:00–12:00 EST; suspended during scheduled macro news releases (FOMC, CPI, NFP, major earnings) within 30 minutes.
